Name: Shepham
ModernLocation: Unknown; on the eastern boundary of the promised land
Description: Shepham was a landmark on the eastern boundary of the land, named between Ain and Riblah in the boundary list of Numbers 34, and again as the boundary ran to the Sea of Chinnereth.
BiblicalSignificance: Shepham is a boundary name: one of the points by which the promised land's eastern edge was drawn before Israel entered it.
